senses.gloss:
(इ) स्पदि r. 1st cl. (स्पन्दते)
1 To quake, to shake, to tremble slightly, to throb, to beat.
2 To go, to move.

n. (-नं)
1 Beating, throbbing, pulsation, quivering.
2 Quickening of the child in the womb.
3 Going.
E.
स्पदि to throb, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Throbbing, beating.
2 Going.
E.
स्पदि to beat, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Throbbing, beating.
2 Gone.
n. (-तं)
Pulsation.
E.
स्पदि to throb, क्त aff.

m. (-ता)
The agent or active cause of pain or distress, as an enemy, an oppressor, a disease, &c.
E.
स्पृ to breathe, aff. तृच्, with इट् augment.

r. 1st cl. (स्पर्द्धते)
To vie, to envy, to desire another's reduction.

mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं)
Envious, emulous.
E.
स्पर्द्ध envy, अच् aff.

f. (-र्द्धा)
1 Envy, emulation, rivalry.
2 Equality, sameness.
3 Successive elevation.
E.
स्पर्द्धा to envy or vie with, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

f. (-ता)
Enviousness, emulation.
E.
स्पर्द्ध, and तल् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Vied or contended with, defied.
E.
स्पर्द्ध to vie with, क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिणी-र्द्धि)
1 Emulous, envious.
2 Superb, gorgeous.
E.
स्पर्द्धा, and इनि aff.

r. 10th cl. (स्पर्शयति)
1 To take.
2 To unite, to join.

m. (-र्शः)
1 Touch, contact.
2 The thing touching or feeling.
3 Gift, donation.
4 Sickness, disease.
5 Morbid heat.
6 A consonant of either of the five first classes of the alphabet.
7 An enemy, a disease, &c., the agent or instrument of pain, trouble, or distress.
8 Air, wind.
f. (-र्शा)
A wanton, an unchaste woman.
E.
स्पृश to touch, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Touching, toucher, that which touches or is in contact with.
E.
स्पृश to touch, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Touch, contact.
2 Gift, donation.
m. (-नः)
Air, wind.
E.
स्पृश to touch, ल्युट् or युच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
What is to be or may be touched, sensible, tangible.
E.
स्पृश to touch, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-णिः)
A stone, the philosopher's stone, converting every thing it touches to gold.
E.
स्पर्श touch, मणि a gem.

n. (-वं)
Gold.
E.
स्पर्शमणि a stone, and प्रभव production.

f. (-ज्जाः)
A sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.)
E.
स्पर्श the touch, and लज्जा ashamed.

f. (-द्धा)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.)
E.
स्पर्श touch, and शुद्धा pure.

m. (-न्दः)
A frog.
E.
स्पर्श the touch, and स्पन्द who goes.

f. (-न्दा)
One of the Apsarasas.
E.
स्पर्श touch, आनन्द delighting.

m. (-र्ष्टा)
1 Morbid heat.
2 The agent or instrument of bodily pain.
E.
स्पृश to touch, aff. तृच्.

r. 1st cl. (स्पशति-ते)
1 To obstruct, to oppose.
2 To string together.
3 To touch.
4 To make evident or clear.
5 To inform.
r. 10th cl. (स्पाशयते)
1 To take.
2 To unite, to connect, or join.

m. (-शः)
1 A spy, a secret agent or emissary.
2 War, battle.
3 Fighting with a dangerous animal, as a tiger, a buffalo, &c. for reward.
E.
स्पश to inform, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Evident, manifest, apparent.
2 Clear, easy, intelligible.
E.
स्पश to make clear, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
Clear, perspicuous, intelligible.
E.
स्पष्ट, and अर्थ sense.

n. (-णं)
Making clear or intelligible.
E.
स्पष्ट, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Explained, expounded, elucidated, made clear, and intelligible.
2 Made manifest, revealed, exposed.
E.
स्पष्ट easy, clear, च्चि augment, and कृत made.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Caused to be stopped, hindered, &c.
E.
स्पश to stop, causal v., क्त aff. form, irr.
